newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bombs wound 5 pro-Israeli militiamen in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Bombs wound 5 pro-Israeli militiamen in Lebanon.

text.p: A roadside bomb wounded two Israeli-backed militiamen just hours after a previous bomb seriously wounded three others in south Lebanon on Wednesday, militia sources said.
The late night explosion hit a South Lebanon Army (SLA) jeep carrying the two militiamen near Kfar Houneh-Aisheih south of Jezzine, the sources said.
Jezzine is officially outside Israel's 15-km (nine miles) deep south Lebanon occupation zone but under SLA control.
The attack was followed by an attack of several Katyusha rockets at the Israeli Dabshe stronghold in the central sector of the zone, they said.
In retaliation for the attack Israeli and SLA artillery units shelled surrounding areas, they added.
Earlier, a roadside bomb explosion seriously wounded three (SLA) militiamen in an armoured troop carrier at Roum-Anan in the Jezzine area.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah group claimed responsibilty for the two attacks.
Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas are fighting to oust Israel and its SLA allies from the occpation zone.
